operationalDefinition: Each path counts correlated visits and follows its ordered stages for 7 × 24 hours after entry. A visit can appear in more than one path. The current date, compute and account filters apply.
operationalMissingExplanation: A dash means a required action or its association was not recorded. Historical counts cannot be reconstructed. A collected stage with no observed actions displays 0.
operationalUnavailable: The data service has not supplied these operational paths. Their counts are unavailable until the service provides this report.
flowPendingHint: Recorded stages can increase during the 7-day observation window. Missing action records keep that stage and every downstream stage unknown.
flowLimitation_retained_history_only: This path uses retained historical events. Removed or unrecorded historical actions cannot be reconstructed.
flowLimitation_operational_stage_not_col: Some required actions or associations were not collected. The affected stage and all downstream stages display a dash.
flowLimitation_operation_filter_not_asso: These visit events cannot be linked to the selected task compute filter. Stage counts are unavailable for this filter.
flowMissingEvent_discovery_proposal_view: Proposal view linked to Roam or Pilot mode
flowMissingEvent_discovery_proposal_deci: Proposal decision linked to Roam or Pilot mode
flowMissingEvent_feature_interacted.file: File opening linked to its category
File download linked to the opened file
flowMissingEvent_discovery_project_opene: Project opening linked to Running or Done status
flowMissingEvent_feature_submit_attempte: Auto submission linked to an operation ID
Auto submission linked to a feature
flowMissingEvent_feature_use_accepted.fi: Confirmed mode linked to the current filters
flowStep_item_interacted: Edited or selected a checklist item
op_draft_submission_definition: Follow a feature visit through its first input action and request submission.
op_draft_abandonment_definition: Follow a feature visit through its first input action and a recorded departure without submission.
op_checklist_interaction_definition: Follow a checklist view through item editing or selection, confirmation, execution and result viewing.
op_landing_workspace_definition: Follow a landing-page visit through the Start exploring call to action and workspace arrival.
op_roam_go_ahead_definition: Follow a Discovery space visit through Roam mode, a proposal view, Go Ahead and successful acceptance of that decision.
op_roam_not_now_definition: Follow a Discovery space visit through Roam mode, a proposal view, Not Now and a successfully skipped proposal.
op_pilot_go_ahead_definition: Follow a Discovery space visit through Pilot mode, a proposal view, Go Ahead and successful acceptance of that decision.
op_pilot_not_now_definition: Follow a Discovery space visit through Pilot mode, a proposal view, Not Now and a successfully skipped proposal.
op_file_upload_definition: Follow a workspace visit through opening the upload control and selecting files.
op_mind_mining_ack_definition: Follow a workspace visit through Mind Mining exposure, a tool click and Got it confirmation.
op_omni_ai_history_ack_definition: Follow a workspace visit through Omni AI History exposure, a tool click and Got it confirmation.
op_quick_collection_ack_definition: Follow a workspace visit through Quick Collection exposure, a tool click and Got it confirmation.
op_files_download_definition: Follow a workspace visit through the Files category, an opened file and its download.
op_files_exit_definition: Follow a workspace visit through the Files category, an opened file and a recorded file exit.
op_projects_download_definition: Follow a workspace visit through the Projects category, an opened file and its download.
op_projects_exit_definition: Follow a workspace visit through the Projects category, an opened file and a recorded file exit.
op_running_open_definition: Follow a workspace visit through clicking a Running project and opening its conversation.
op_done_open_definition: Follow a workspace visit through clicking a Done project and opening its conversation.
autoRoutingDefinition: Count each Auto operation once using its backend-confirmed mode. Task, Discuss and Loop shares use confirmed-mode operations as the denominator. Unconfirmed or unlinked submissions are shown separately.
autoRoutingUnavailable: Auto routing data is unavailable. Submission and mode-confirmation records must be linked before these counts can be reported.
autoRoutingPartial: Auto submission or mode-confirmation coverage is incomplete. Recorded counts are shown and percentages remain undefined.
autoRoutingRatio: Share of Auto operations with a confirmed mode
autoRoutingAccepted: Auto operations with a confirmed mode
autoRoutingExcludedDefinition: Missing operation IDs or associations can prevent reliable deduplication of excluded submission records. These are counted as records separately from attributable operations.
